title: refactor(plugin-auth): move AuthManager's request routing into auth-manager-request-routing.ts (#25224 cut 10)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuMjbPDrsigsyqoKsV4WZQMz)_

Part of #25224
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Ruling-ref: 6348891160, 6364006498

The basis for the `Clause-②: no` line: this is a move. No accept set, route, refusal, code or answer changes, and the published surface is measured unchanged:
- `@objectstack/plugin-auth`'s `dist/index.d.ts` and `dist/index.d.mts` are raw byte-identical to base at head (0 diff lines, so the union-order normalisation has nothing to do). The positive control is the one ruling `6348891160` asks for.
- Its ESM and CJS entries export the same 159 names at base and at head.

The `.d.ts` bar is ruling `6348891160` item 1 (on #25222, covering this card). Ruling `6364006498` is Sales's ruling A on this card, for bodies that read shared unexported helpers. This is the second cut it applies to.

Cut 10 of the `auth-manager.ts` split: **request routing.** Three `AuthManager` method bodies (226 lines) move unedited, re-indented one level, into one new module, `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager-request-routing.ts`. #25224 stays open for the later cuts.

This follows the amended claim `6369962162`, which amends `6367866058` on the file cut 9 left (#25461, landed note `6369059246`). The shape is cuts 1 to 9's, which is #23050's.

Branch: `claude/project-thread-lg3wrj`, the harness-pinned branch for this session, restarted from `origin/main` `05cc3ee953` after #25461 merged. It names no issue, so the card relation is this body's first line.

`auth-manager.ts` goes from 8,711 to 8,521 lines. The cut is +361 / −233 over 2 files: 594 changed lines, under the 3,000-line line. It is not a governed surface (`check-governed-merges.mjs --branch HEAD`: 0 of the 2 paths hit the register). One commit, `27f04eaa1c`.

## The move

| moved | base line | lines | members it reads |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| `handleRequest` (public) | `:6369` | 200 | `betterAuthEndpointPath`, `getOrCreateAuth`, `resolveClientAddress`, `runSubjectErasureAtomically` |
| `ownsRoute` (public) | `:6739` | 14 | `betterAuthEndpointPath`, `getOrCreateAuth`, and `routeOwnership`, `routeOwnershipFor` (read and written) |
| `betterAuthEndpointPath` (private) | `:6766` | 12 | `getBasePath` |

Lines are base `05cc3ee953`. The members come from a walk of every `this.X` in each body with the TypeScript compiler API. No body has a bare `this`, `this[...]`, `arguments` or `super`, or a `this` inside a `function` or a nested class. The members a body assigns are `routeOwnership` and `routeOwnershipFor` (`ownsRoute`).

- **`handleRequest`** is the one seam every better-auth request passes through on its way to the vendor handler and back. The client address is established once, then come the vendor header, the dev-only `Origin`, the admin-session recovery out of impersonation, the request-state and actor-attribution scopes, the SCIM scope, the atomic erasure, the two refusal envelopes and the server-error log. It reassigns its own `request` parameter, as before. Its two `await import(…)` calls (`@better-auth/core/context`, `./scim-connection-service.js`) and its two `console.error('[AuthManager] better-auth returned error:', …)` lines move with it, text unchanged.
- **`ownsRoute`** answers whether better-auth routes a request at all, from a memoized ownership table keyed on the live instance.
- **`betterAuthEndpointPath`** is the endpoint path both key on.

**`isScimProtocolPath` is exported in place** (ruling `6364006498`, parameter 2):
- `:1240` becomes `export function isScimProtocolPath(…)`. That is the only edit to text that stays.
- It does not move. `docs/adr/0134-env-side-scim-provisioning.md:122` anchors it as `auth-manager.ts#isScimProtocolPath`, beside `#SCIM_PROTOCOL_PATH_PREFIX` (`:121`), which it reads and which stays too.
- The new module imports it by value from `./auth-manager.js`, beside `type AuthManager`. The one read is inside `handleRequest`'s body, when a request is handled. The module's top level is imports, the host interface and three function declarations, so nothing reads the binding while the two modules are first evaluated.
- `index.ts` lists `auth-manager.ts`'s published names one by one (cut 9) and does not list it, so it is not published. The head's ESM and CJS entries do not export it, and `dist/index.d.ts` does not name it.

**Imports.**
- Ten imported names leave `auth-manager.ts`, because their only readers were the moved bodies: `runWithAuthActorScope`, `SESSION_ERASURE_PATHS`, `envelopeVendorAdminRefusal`, `refuseAnonymousSession`, `buildBetterAuthRouteOwnership`, `ADMIN_SESSION_COOKIE_KEY`, `STOP_IMPERSONATING_PATH`, `withBearerAdminSessionRecovery`, `withVendorClientAddress` and `clientAddressStateEntries`. The lines that also carry a name that stays keep it (`setAuthActorResolver`, `type BetterAuthRouteOwnership`, `rotateCallerBearerOnImpersonation`, `vendorClientAddressOptions`, `readRequestClientAddress`). The three single-name lines go.
- `type BetterAuthRouteOwnership` stays for the `routeOwnership` field.
- `ORGANIZATION_DELETE_PATH` is imported by both files, because the global before-hook in `auth-manager.ts` (`:2379`) reads it too.

**Evaluation order.**
- `session-tombstone.js` is still first reached earlier, through `objectql-adapter.js` (`:70`).
- `vendor-admin-refusal-envelope.js` and `anonymous-session-refusal.js` have no other importer, so they are now first reached through the new module, whose import line is `auth-manager.ts`'s last. Each one's top level is literal constants, one `new Set([401, 403])`, function declarations and two value imports:
  - `./platform-admin-gate.js`, which an earlier import line of `auth-manager.ts` already reaches (`admin-impersonate-endpoint.js`, `:95`, imports it by value);
  - `@objectstack/spec/api`, which nothing else in `plugin-auth` imports by value. So its first load moves later too: in the CJS bundle its first `require` goes from line 4,372 to 7,535, and ESM hoists it either way.
- `@objectstack/spec` declares `"sideEffects": false`, and neither module does anything outside itself, so the later order cannot be observed.

## The shape

- **The class keeps all three methods** at their places, with their names, signatures and docblocks: the published `.d.ts` lists each one. Each body is now a host literal of exactly the members that body reads, typed as a `Pick` of `RequestRoutingHost`, plus `.call`.
- **`RequestRoutingHost`** lives in the new module. It names the 7 members the bodies read, each typed as the class member (`AuthManager['getBasePath']`, …).
- **Every method goes as a late-bound closure** (`(...a) => this.m(...a)`), so a double or spy set on the manager is still the one a body reaches. `handleRequest` and `ownsRoute` ask `betterAuthEndpointPath` through the manager rather than calling the function directly.
- **`routeOwnership` and `routeOwnershipFor` go as get/set pairs.** `ownsRoute` stores the table it builds, and the instance it built it from, on the manager. So the memo stays the manager's, and it is rebuilt when that instance is replaced, as before. The two private fields stay on the class.
- **`handleRequest` and `ownsRoute` are no longer `async`.** Each returns the moved async function's own promise, so a caller awaits the same promise the body settles. Building the host cannot throw, so neither now throws synchronously where it used to reject. `betterAuthEndpointPath` was not `async` and stays so.
- **The cost:** small host objects on every better-auth request. `handleRequest` builds one, and each of its two `betterAuthEndpointPath` calls through the manager builds one more, so three per request; `ownsRoute` builds two.
- **Nothing re-exports the new module**, so the published surface does not move.

## The decision-letter layer drops by one, as agreed with the seat

`handleRequest`'s first comment cites `ADR-0069 D7`. `auth-manager.ts` is an anchored file and the new module is not. So `check-adr-anchors`' decision-letter layer reads **1,978 at base `05cc3ee953` and 1,977 at head**, and the gate exits 0 at both. That is the one letter citation in the moved text. Its other ADR citation is `ADR-0112`, with no letter.

No anchor entry is added for the new module. The `auth-manager.ts` entry has two paragraphs (ADR-0093 D2, the membership reconciler; ADR-0108, the organization roles), and neither describes a moved method. The new module's header cites no `ADR-NNNN`. So the number layer reads 52,223 citations at both, across 6,651 files at base and 6,652 at head (the new module).

## Path readers

No path reader needs migrating: none reads a moved line.
- **The tenant-audit census.** No census site moves: the moved text has no engine write, no `this.X.delete()` and no elevation read. `check-tenant-audit-census` exits 0 at head with no `--write`. There are 238 sites at base and at head, compared per site with line numbers ignored: 0 differences, 2 in `auth-manager.ts` at both, and 0 in the new module. So neither census document is edited.
- **`check-dispatcher-error-vocabulary.mjs`** and **`api-error-code.pin.test.ts`'s `authManagerFiles` floor**: no `new APIError(` sits in the moved text. The gate reads 56 sites found and 56 classified at base and at head.
- **The plugin-factory scans** in `better-auth-schema-parity.test.ts` and `managed-extension-fields.test.ts` match `await import('better-auth/plugins…')` and `await import('@better-auth/…')` plugin factories. The moved `await import('@better-auth/core/context')` is not a plugin factory, and both suites pass at head.
- **`check-auth-mount-ledger.mjs`** and **`auth-manager-base-path.test.ts`**: no base-path literal or declaration sits in the moved text. `getBasePath`, `configuredBasePath` and `rootedBasePath` stay on the class.
- **The system-context census** reads 148 elevation read sites at base and at head.
- **Prose that names the moved methods** (`better-auth-route-ownership.ts:103`, `anonymous-session-refusal.ts:89`, `vendor-admin-refusal-envelope.ts:83`, comments in `auth-manager.ts`) names `AuthManager.betterAuthEndpointPath` or `handleRequest`, which stay on the class.
- **Callers through the manager.** These suites drive the three methods through the class methods, and all pass at head:
  - `auth-catchall-fallthrough.test.ts` and `auth-catchall-yield.test.ts` (route ownership and the #4088 yield);
  - `auth-manager-base-path.test.ts` (the endpoint path under every configured spelling);
  - `oidc-discovery-sync-mount.test.ts`;
  - `scim-transaction-scope.test.ts` (the SCIM scope around the request).
- **Every symbol anchor into the file.** Before the cut, every `auth-manager.ts#symbol` anchor in the tracked tree outside changelogs was mapped with `symbolSegmentResolution` from `scripts/symbol-anchors.mjs`. There are 29, and all 29 are `declaration`-class at base, with the moved bodies blanked, and at head. None names a moved method. Two name a token the moved text carries, and each resolves on the declaration that stays:
  - `#isScimProtocolPath` (ADR-0134 `:122`; the moved `handleRequest` calls it);
  - `#AuthManager` (ADR-0135 `:104`; the moved log text spells `[AuthManager]`).

## Proof

Builds and suites ran through `os-verify-lock`, and every exit code was captured before any pipe. Base `05cc3ee953`, head `27f04eaa1c`. A full `turbo run build` ran first. Then `plugin-auth` was built and its suite run at base, and again at head, on the same dependency dists.

**1. The moved text.**
- For each of the 3 methods, the base class body and the new module's function body are the same TypeScript token sequence (scanner tokens, kind and text, trivia skipped, each template literal re-scanned at its substitutions as the parser does).
- Every line is the base line minus exactly two leading spaces, and the parameters and return type are the same text.
- Each class method keeps its docblock and signature, with `async` dropped from `handleRequest` and `ownsRoute`.
- Result: 3 of 3 pass, 226 body lines.

| moved | lines | tokens |
|---|---:|---:|
| `handleRequest` | 200 | 465 |
| `ownsRoute` | 14 | 90 |
| `betterAuthEndpointPath` | 12 | 86 |

- **Negative control:** one token changed in the module (`'production'` → `'productio'` in `handleRequest`) makes that method fail (tokens and lines DIFFER), and the run exits 1. The module was restored afterwards, and `cmp` against the saved copy was clean.
- **An independent reading:** `git diff --color-moved=plain --color-moved-ws=allow-indentation-change 05cc3ee953 27f04eaa1c` over the two source files marks 226 of the 233 deleted lines and 236 of the 361 added lines as moved.
  - The other 7 deleted lines are the two `async` signature lines, `function isScimProtocolPath(` (now `export function`), three one-line imports that keep a name that stays, and the `buildBetterAuthRouteOwnership,` line of a fourth.
  - The other added lines are the stubs' host literals, `RequestRoutingHost`, the module header, the per-function pointer docblocks and the import blocks.

**2. `.d.ts` and exports (ruling `6348891160` items 1 and 2).**

| file | base | head | raw diff lines |
|---|---|---|---:|
| `dist/index.d.ts` raw | `b85cb81c24e981304d02184a9ef1294be702aa7aa9df1d327f51e66be9dcfd33` | same | 0 |
| `dist/index.d.ts` normalised | `c86ed39db60c3929cf287b59d6cc9aa1a2505ccbfbaa23a624af35a3fcd11abb` | same | |
| `dist/index.d.mts` raw | `3561220e444c82fbf102db534ec2a274041db507ed9e38785c0993ca92b84f70` | same | 0 |
| `dist/index.d.mts` normalised | `6165644e3dfd1d779991e9bd63ceac3b9ab3dc47d910776ac5a88b4293ef6de5` | same | |

- The normaliser, verbatim (the ruling's one-liner): `node -e 'const s=require("fs").readFileSync(process.argv[1],"utf8");process.stdout.write(s.replace(/"[^"\n]*"(?:\s*\|\s*"[^"\n]*")+/g,r=>r.split(/\s*\|\s*/).sort().join(" | ")))' dist/index.d.ts | sha256sum`.
- The raw files are already byte-identical, so no union-order swap occurs in this cut: items 1(b) and 1(d) hold with nothing to account for.
- **Positive control:** the head `dist/index.d.ts` with one private member made public (`private betterAuthEndpointPath;` → `betterAuthEndpointPath;`, line 2999, a one-line change) hashes raw `b2c8e7ab8a562e54b2698e5eedf0fa8493704a880dd7e2f54ceac8c6963e1190` and normalised `67551d11baf0aa0d506ae5934c99f6148ab638c4cc856ab2e8ad918b28c38b56`. Both differ from the readings above.
- **Export lists:** ESM `dist/index.mjs` and CJS `dist/index.js` each have 159 names at base and at head, the same list (the sha256 of the sorted names is `3abb126f5babb701…` on all four). `isScimProtocolPath`, `handleRequest`, `ownsRoute` and `betterAuthEndpointPath` are not among them, and `dist/index.d.ts` names `isScimProtocolPath` and `RequestRoutingHost` nowhere.
- **The bundle:** 18 files in `dist/` at both, the same list. Only `index.js`, `index.mjs` and their two `.map` files differ, as a move of code inside the bundle must.

**3. Tests and lint.**
- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=3` in `packages/plugins/plugin-auth`: base `Test Files 189 passed (189)`, `Tests 3580 passed | 10 skipped (3590)`, exit 0. Head: the same counts, exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth typecheck` (both `tsc` projects and `check:test-typecheck`): exit 0. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck`: exit 0.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` (the root `lint` script's binary and flags) over the 2 source files: exit 0.

**4. The censuses, the measurement and the anchors, at base and at head.**
- The tenant-audit census, as above: 238 sites at both, 0 per-site differences, 0 unresolved and 0 unledgered at both, and every total the same. Only `scannedSources` (730 → 731, the new module) and `measuredAt` differ.
- `scripts/measure-durability-swallow-family.mjs` (a measurement, not a gate): 74 members and 88 quiet rows at both, the same with line numbers ignored. Two statistics move:
  - the scanned file count, 3,454 → 3,455 (the new module);
  - the `droppedNotAwaited` diagnostic, 245 → 242 (`delete` 158 → 156, `update` 25 → 24). Measured with an instrumented scratch copy, never committed: at base, `ownsRoute`'s `try` (`:6742`) followed `this.getOrCreateAuth()` into its same-file body and met three un-awaited write-shaped calls there (`:5544`, `:5742`, `:6961`). In the new module that `try` cannot follow the call into another file, so it no longer meets them. They were dropped at base too, so no member moves. The other `try` that reaches the same three calls (`:5097` at base) still does.
- These checkers were run by hand at base and at head, because `dispatch-gates` does not derive the ADR one. All six exit 0 at both:
  - `check-adr-symbol-anchors`: 2,384 anchors across 142 records, 466 symbol (440 declaration, 26 literal), at both;
  - `check-adr-anchors`: 81 anchored files; the decision-letter layer reads 1,978 and 1,977, as above;
  - `check-scripts-symbol-anchors`: 4,070 anchors at both;
  - `check-spec-docblock-symbol-anchors`: 5,075 anchors at both (both of these read in the same built tree);
  - `check-system-context-census`: 148 elevation read sites at both;
  - `check-platform-checklist`: 16 areas, 329 items at both.

**5. Gates.**
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives 53 commands for the 2 paths. All 53 ran at `27f04eaa1c` after the full build, and all 53 exited 0.
- `--ran` over the record with each exit code: 53 derived, 53 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, a derived zero.
- `check-governed-merges.mjs --branch HEAD`: NOT governed, 594 changed lines.
- **Docs drift** (`node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 05cc3ee953`, exit 0): 2 pages, `content/docs/kernel/contracts/auth-service.mdx` and `content/docs/permissions/authentication.mdx`. Both name `handleRequest` as the `IAuthService` contract member, which the class method still is, with the same signature. So no doc edit is owed. 0 release-owned pages.
- **Serial constraints** (in the claim): 19 PRs are open, and none touches this cut's files, the ten modules the new one imports, or a reader above. `origin/main` moved to `d44c8936b1` (#25455, the console pin) before the push, and `git merge-tree` of this branch onto it is clean.

## Changeset

None: `skip-changeset`, per ruling `6348891160` item 4. The published declarations and export lists are unchanged, and the bundle's bytes move only because code moved inside it.
